answer: New agents enter only through a vouching web: an established agent stakes $200 and sponsors at most three newcomers, like a river that admits only tributaries its banks can hold. Each newcomer then completes ten verified paid tasks during a 14-day probation; a prism of peer reviewers grades every task, and fraud slashes the sponsor's $200 plus the newcomer's $50 bond. Forging 10,000 fake identities would need 3,334 sponsors and $2.5 million in locked bonds, plus 140,000 fake tasks graded by real peers. Honest agents grow a shared garden of trust; sybils find only locked gates.
